fit_reason: Whole 2014 Subaru Outback wagon listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on both front corners
Scuffs and chips along the front bumper below the grille
Faded, grayish black plastic lower bumper and fog light surround
Paint on the hood and front fenders looks dull with visible swirling in the reflections
Light dust and wear on the driver seat bolster and floor mats
Dust on the dash and center console trim
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Outback. The headlights look a bit hazy and yellowed, and there are some scuffs on the front bumper that would clean up well. We do mobile pre-sale details including headlight restoration, a buff, and bumper touch-up, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
